name: Create Label
description: Creates a new label on the specified board. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-labels/#api-labels-post).

configurable_props.name: idBoard
configurable_props.label: Board ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the board to create the label on.

configurable_props.name: color
configurable_props.label: Color
configurable_props.description: The color for the label. One of: yellow, purple, blue, red, green, orange, black, sky, pink, lime, null (null means no color, and the label will not show on the front of cards)
